llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger terms could cause over-invocation in ambiguous conversations, but the artifact does not show automatic file processing or hidden execution outside user-directed audio/TTS workflows.
[SSD-3] expected: Echoing transcripts into chat is a real privacy consideration, but it is explicitly shown in the OpenClaw configuration and described as part of the voice-message path rather than hidden behavior.
[VirusTotal] expected: Supplied telemetry is clean across engines and does not conflict with the artifact review.
[staticScan] expected: Supplied static scan metadata is clean, and local artifact inspection found only LICENSE, README.md, and SKILL.md.
llm.guidance: Install this only if you want a local voice toolkit and are comfortable with a global Bun package plus downloaded model assets. If voice notes may contain sensitive speech, consider changing OpenClaw's transcript echo setting before use, because the documented setup copies recognized speech into chat history/context.
llm.summary: This skill is a coherent local voice transcription and speech tool, with disclosed privacy implications when transcripts are echoed into OpenClaw chat.
